title: Rusty review pass 2: jmap-client
notes:
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — code is structurally sound; no unsafe, no unwrap outside tests, error type is non_exhaustive with thiserror. Remaining findings are: two API-level issues (stringly-typed error payloads, unvalidated sha256 type) and a cluster of .to_string()-on-&str/-literal inconsistencies that clippy would catch with str_to_string enabled.
Rust idiom confidence: 85% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: JMAP-3e0.5 (parse_ws_frame type_name allocation — the current code is functional and the borrow restructure is a mild preference), JMAP-3e0.9 (literal string inconsistency within same file is real but borderline). Uncertainty driven by: not running cargo clippy with all optional lints enabled (str_to_string, as_conversions); could not inspect full feature matrix for hidden code paths.
